label: DESIGN-K
per_surface_notes: Surfaces present: ENTRY (catalogue index: hero + folder sections with card grid), DISCOVERY and INTERACTION (folder pages with a 3-column card grid and prev/next footer), DETAIL (a full-screen rendered sign-up form with a fixed bottom bar: back link + keyboard-shortcut hints). Full-page files taller than the viewport were viewed via scratchpad crops derived from the listed originals; ENTRY-desktop.png (17003px) and ENTRY-mobile.png (22377px) render only the hero and folder 01, with the remaining ~15000px empty and 9 of 12 cards in folder 01 as blank bordered boxes (unmounted lazy content); this was treated as a capture/lazy-load artefact and not penalised except where noted as NOT_VERIFIED. The state-DETAIL-mobile-nav-open.png capture shows a different rendered design (a pricing page) with the same fixed bottom bars. Dark theme throughout; fonts appear to be fallbacks and were not penalised.

verdicts.reason: ENTRY and DISCOVERY use a familiar catalogue pattern: brand bar top-left with a count top-right, hero headline + paragraph, sectioned card grid with title and filename under each thumbnail, and prev/next links in the footer. Novelty is limited to the monospace meta labels and the keyboard-shortcut bar on DETAIL, which is purposeful for a code catalogue.

ENTRY has no button; its single action type is opening a design card, and the first cards are visible at the bottom of the 1440x900 first screen with nothing competing. On DETAIL the filled full-width 'Create account' button is clearly the primary action against the outlined GitHub/Google buttons.

Reading order can be numbered from size and position alone: on ENTRY the large serif headline (1), the paragraph beneath (2), then the '01 Layouts' section title (3); on DETAIL the card title 'Create your account' (1), the subtitle (2), then the OAuth buttons and form (3).

Labels sit directly above their inputs and card titles/filenames sit tight under their thumbnails, with much larger gaps between cards and between sections (divider plus ~100px before each folder title). Related items are visibly closer than unrelated ones.

The hero headline on ENTRY is surrounded by the largest whitespace on the page (roughly 150px above the pill and 100px below the paragraph before the divider), while card grids are packed tighter. On DETAIL the form card is centred in a large empty field.

The only chromatic accents are a muted steel-blue on status counters ('12 DE 12 PRONTOS', 'PASTA 03 DE 18') and the hero pill, a saturated blue on the actionable 'Sign in'/'Terms'/'Privacy' links, and green check marks on the DETAIL reassurance badges. Body text, cards and chrome remain neutral grey, so the accent is reserved for status and actions.

Colours read as a system: near-black page ground, a slightly lighter card surface, grey borders, white/grey text, one blue accent, green for the check marks, plus third-party brand marks on the GitHub/Google buttons. No stray colours appear in the site chrome.

Site-chrome icons are all thin-stroke outline glyphs of one optical size: the check marks in the top badges, the eye/eye-off toggle in the password field, and the arrow glyphs inside the keyboard-key chips of the bottom bar. The GitHub and Google marks are brand logos rather than a second icon family.

The 'Create account' button is rendered in a flat grey (measured ~rgb(126,126,126)) with darker label text, signalling a disabled state by colour alone with no text or icon explaining it; the password strength meter is three unlabelled grey bars. Positive states elsewhere (badges with check icon + text, 'x DE y PRONTOS') do carry text.
verdicts.measured_value: Disabled-looking grey submit button and 3-bar strength meter with no text or icon
verdicts.expected_value: State conveyed by text or icon in addition to colour

verdicts.reason: Content volume is high (header states '158 DESIGNS · 18 PASTAS') but no search input or search button exists on any surface: the header has only the brand and count, and the DETAIL keyboard bar offers índice/anterior/seguinte/pasta/aleatório/escuro/código with no search.
verdicts.measured_value: No search control on any of the four surfaces; 158 items across 18 folders
verdicts.expected_value: A keyboard-reachable search input or button for a catalogue of this volume

verdicts.reason: On ENTRY/DISCOVERY/INTERACTION at 390 wide the navigation is the visible index and prev/next footer links with comfortable targets. On DETAIL at 390 wide the two fixed bottom bars (back link + keyboard-shortcut chips) stack to ~180px and overlap the form, covering the Terms checkbox and most of the 'Create account' button; state-DETAIL-mobile-nav-open.png shows the same bars covering the pricing card's price.
verdicts.measured_value: Fixed nav bars overlap the checkbox and submit button at 390x844
verdicts.expected_value: Navigation visible or behind a labelled >=44px toggle without overflowing onto content

verdicts.reason: Complexity is revealed in layers: ENTRY lists folders with a one-line description and count, DISCOVERY shows one folder's cards, DETAIL opens a single design full-screen, and the code is kept behind the 'c CÓDIGO' shortcut rather than shown inline.

INTERACTION has only navigation actions (card hover shows a brighter border in state-INTERACTION-hover-first.png). DETAIL has a form, but in state-DETAIL-form-submit-empty.png the only visible change is the password eye icon toggling to eye-off, so the capture does not show whether a submit produced feedback.

Full-page captures show unloaded thumbnails as plain bordered card boxes (9 of 12 in ENTRY folder 01, and the lower half of ENTRY is empty), but the screenshots cannot distinguish a designed placeholder from lazy content that had not mounted at capture time, and no spinner/skeleton was captured.
A three-field sign-up form exists on DETAIL, but no typing or blur state was captured (state-DETAIL-focus-first.png focuses the skip link, not a field), so inline validation cannot be verified.
No destructive action appears on any surface: the catalogue pages only browse and the DETAIL form creates an account.

The first screen states what the site is ('158 designs em 18 pastas...') and the first design cards are already visible at the bottom of the 1440x900 viewport and just below the fold at 390 wide, so the core content is one scroll away.
No surface shows an empty collection or empty result: every folder reports 'x DE x PRONTOS' and the DETAIL form is a sign-up. The blank card boxes are unloaded thumbnails, not an empty state.

Help is placed at the point of use rather than in a tour: each folder has a one-line description under its title, the DETAIL password field carries 'At least 8 characters', the card says 'It only takes a minute', and the keyboard shortcuts are listed in the bottom bar where they apply.
No multi-step flow exists on the captured surfaces; the DETAIL sign-up is a single step (a stepper appears only inside a thumbnail of another design).
No testimonials appear on any surface.

Numbers used as claims are specific and self-sourced from the catalogue itself: '158 DESIGNS · 18 PASTAS', '12 DE 12 PRONTOS', '14 DE 14 PRONTOS', '4 DE 4 PRONTOS', and 'FREE FOR 14 DAYS' on DETAIL; no vague quantities appear.

DETAIL is a sign-up decision point; it shows risk-reversal badges (FREE FOR 14 DAYS / NO CREDIT CARD / CANCEL ANYTIME) but no social proof such as customer logos, ratings or user counts anywhere near the form. The catalogue surfaces have no decision point.
verdicts.measured_value: No logos, ratings or user counts on the sign-up surface
verdicts.expected_value: Social proof positioned at the sign-up decision point

verdicts.reason: The data-collecting DETAIL form shows policy signals: an 'I agree to the Terms and Privacy' checkbox with links, a 'NO CREDIT CARD' badge, a password visibility toggle and a strength meter.

state-DETAIL-form-submit-empty.png shows no error message next to any field, but the only visible change versus the base capture is the password eye icon toggling to eye-off and the submit button appears disabled, so the capture does not show an invalid submission actually being processed.
The DETAIL form has three fields (Full name, Email, Password) plus a consent checkbox and none carries a visible required or optional marker: no asterisk, no '(optional)', no legend.
verdicts.measured_value: 0 of 3 labelled fields marked required or optional
verdicts.expected_value: Required or optional fields consistently marked with a visible indicator

verdicts.reason: The 'Create account' button is rendered in a flat disabled grey (~rgb(126,126,126)) with dim label text before any input, and nothing on the card explains what must be completed to enable it; no submitting/success/failure state was captured either.
verdicts.measured_value: Disabled-looking submit button with no explanatory text
verdicts.expected_value: Submit never disabled without explanation; submitting/success/failure visible
